name: Vaakevandring
description: '''Vaakevandring''' was a Norwegian [[unblack metal]] band active from 1996 to 2007. The band name refers to the [[resurrection of Jesus]]. Vaakevandring played [[symphonic black metal]] with influences from [[Music of Norway#Traditional and folk music|Norwegian folk music]].{{sfn|Sharpe-Young|2001|p=367}}
